body:
Draft [PR #52](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/pull/52) now packages source-bound held-native retention and integrates it into serial generation. All 129 locked tests, hooks and both GitHub checks pass. A fully preserved/readback-verified and cleaned failure stays scientifically unaccepted; later groups may run only with admission open. [Installed evidence and limits](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/2796424c/experiments/51-held-retention/installed-results.md).

The real archived #47 failure passed automatic log binding, both-control/source/worker checks, anonymous HF readback and verification of the already completed original cleanup. The actual built-wheel CLI independently verified original source through local preservation with transport/credentials forbidden. Original raw bytes, native rewards and held journal remain unchanged. No new native job, cleanup or model call was used for this extraction.

Support covers only pinned native reward disagreement; unknown/unsafe evidence and uncertain/budget-held cases remain held. No manual task hash inputs, score/parser/task repair, acceptance of late files or upstream modification. Fresh native execution/cleanup through the installed candidate is the separate [#53](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/issues/53) regression. Keep this issue/epic/PR open for review; no automatic merge or dataset release. Detailed logs and exact HF receipts are in comments.
